Container.Name: Python_HA_Learning_Thermostat
Container.Overview: Reinforcement learning thermostat engine integrated with Home Assistant and SENS55 air quality ventilation rails.

Config.Name: Appdata Storage Workspace
Config.Description: Persistent array folder for brain.db and execution state metrics.

Config.Name: Home Assistant Token
Config.Description: Long-Lived Access Token generated inside Home Assistant profile settings.

Config.Name: Home Assistant Address
Config.Description: The local LAN IP address and network port target for your Home Assistant core.

Config.Name: Enable AQ Features
Config.Description: Enables automated swamp cooler ventilation features and scales override penalties.

Config.Name: Swamp Cooler Switch ID
Config.Description: Home Assistant switch used to trigger active venting cycles.
